title: tactics4sby proof strategy
description: JSON Schema for the proof strategy files read by parser.py. Reference it from a strategy file with "$schema": "../proof_strategy.schema.json" so that editors validate and complete it as you type. The schema covers everything the parser accepts; the cross-tree rules the parser also enforces (no assume_guarantee nested inside another one, and inductive_assume_guarantee only with "assume_early": false) cannot be expressed here and are reported by the parser instead.

$schema.description: Optional URI of this schema, used by editors to validate the file.

nonEmptyString.description: A string that is not empty and does not consist solely of whitespace.

nullableString.description: An optional string; an explicit null is accepted and treated as absent.

stringArray.description: A list of non-empty strings. May be empty unless stated otherwise.

nullableStringArray.description: An optional list of strings; an explicit null is accepted and treated as absent.

proofStrategy.description: The design under verification together with the goals to prove on it.

header.description: Yosys commands run once, in order, before any goal is processed. Relative paths are resolved against the directory containing the strategy file.

files.description: Source files considered by the generated sby configuration scripts. May be empty.

subgoals.description: Additional goals that are proven independently of the main goal. May be omitted or empty.

assume_early.description: Whether assumptions inside processes read current signal values (true, the default) or previous ones (false). Must be false to use the inductive_assume_guarantee tactic.

options.description: Global sby options, active for every task.

engines.description: Global sby engines, active for every task.

goal.description: A verification goal: the contract (all assertions and assumptions) of one module.

module.description: Name of the module to analyze. It must exist after the header commands have run.

name.description: Optional label for logs and error messages; has no semantic effect.

tactic.description: How to decompose the goal. Omit it (or use null) to prove the goal directly.

instance.description: A module instance taking part in an assume-guarantee decomposition.

name.description: Name of the instance cell (or of its module).

tactic.description: Tactic used to prove this instance's verification condition. Omit it (or use null) to prove that VC directly.
One of the supported tactics, selected by its "name" field.

nullableTactic.description: An optional tactic; an explicit null is accepted and treated as absent.

noneTactic.description: No decomposition. Useful to set options and engines for a verification condition without splitting it further.

assumeGuaranteeTactic.description: Acyclic assume-guarantee decomposition over the module's submodule instances. It may not appear anywhere inside the subtree of another assume-guarantee tactic; prove such a sub-goal separately as a subgoal.

auto.description: Compute the instance order automatically (true, the default) or take it from 'instances' (false).

instances.description: Instances taking part in the decomposition, and their order when 'auto' is false. Required (and non-empty) when 'auto' is false, where every instance not listed is inlined. Names must be pairwise distinct.

inline.description: Instances to inline. Only allowed when 'instances' is absent and 'auto' is true; every other instance then takes part in the decomposition. Names must be pairwise distinct.

tactic.description: Tactic used to prove the main verification condition of this goal.

allOf.description: Manual ordering requires an explicit 'instances' order.

inductiveAssumeGuaranteeTactic.description: Assume-guarantee decomposition for apparently circular reasoning: each instance's assumptions are proven at time t assuming the other modules' assertions up to t-1. Structurally identical to assume_guarantee and subject to the same nesting rule, but it may only be used in automatic mode and requires the top-level 'assume_early' field to be false.

auto.description: The inductive variant must run in automatic mode; the field may be omitted.

instances.description: Instances taking part in the decomposition. Names must be pairwise distinct.

tactic.description: Tactic used to prove the main verification condition of this goal.

abstractTactic.description: Apply user-defined abstraction commands, then optionally continue with another tactic.

commands.description: Yosys commands to add to the generated sby script. Each must start with 'abstract' or 'cutpoint'.

tactic.description: Tactic applied after the commands. Omit it (or use null) to prove the result directly.

splitTactic.description: Case split on a width-1 wire of the module owning the verification condition.

split_wire.description: Expression to split on, evaluated in the module owning the verification condition.

case_false.description: Tactic for the branch where 'split_wire' is false. Omit it (or use null) to prove that branch directly.

case_true.description: Tactic for the branch where 'split_wire' is true. Omit it (or use null) to prove that branch directly.
